@use '@angular/material' as mat;
@use 'sass:map';
@use 'tokens' as t;

// Keystone Material theme. Palettes from brand (KEY-0471); do not adjust without sign-off.

$ks-primary-palette: (
  50: #e3ecf2,
  100: #b9cfdd,
  200: #8cb0c7,
  300: #5f90b0,
  400: #3d789f,
  500: t.$ks-navy,
  600: #0a3753,
  700: #082f48,
  800: #06273e,
  900: #03192b,
  A100: #6fb6ff,
  A200: #3c9dff,
  A400: #0984ff,
  A700: #0077ef,
  contrast: (
    50: rgba(black, 0.87),
    100: rgba(black, 0.87),
    200: rgba(black, 0.87),
    300: white,
    400: white,
    500: white,
    600: white,
    700: white,
    800: white,
    900: white,
    A100: rgba(black, 0.87),
    A200: white,
    A400: white,
    A700: white,
  )
);

$ks-accent-palette: (
  50: #fcf7e9,
  100: #f8ecc8,
  200: #f3e0a4,
  300: #eed380,
  400: #ebcb75,
  500: t.$ks-gold,
  600: #d9b25a,
  700: #c9a04a,
  800: #b98f3a,
  900: #9e7222,
  A100: #ffffff,
  A200: #fff5dd,
  A400: #ffe6aa,
  A700: #ffde90,
  contrast: (
    50: rgba(black, 0.87),
    100: rgba(black, 0.87),
    200: rgba(black, 0.87),
    300: rgba(black, 0.87),
    400: rgba(black, 0.87),
    500: rgba(black, 0.87),
    600: rgba(black, 0.87),
    700: rgba(black, 0.87),
    800: white,
    900: white,
    A100: rgba(black, 0.87),
    A200: rgba(black, 0.87),
    A400: rgba(black, 0.87),
    A700: rgba(black, 0.87),
  )
);

$ks-primary: mat.define-palette($ks-primary-palette, 500, 300, 700);
$ks-accent: mat.define-palette($ks-accent-palette, 500, 300, 700);
$ks-warn: mat.define-palette(mat.$red-palette, 700);

$ks-typography: mat.define-typography-config(
  $font-family: '"Source Sans 3", "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif',
  $button: mat.define-typography-level(15px, 36px, 600),
  $input: mat.define-typography-level(16px, 1.125, 400)
);

$ks-theme: mat.define-light-theme((
  color: (
    primary: $ks-primary,
    accent: $ks-accent,
    warn: $ks-warn,
  ),
  typography: $ks-typography,
  density: 0,
));

@include mat.core();

@include mat.all-component-themes($ks-theme);
